clips.title: The story
paras: Thork needs supplies back at the Crossroads after Razormane quilboar raids. The stolen crates hold provisions the outpost needs amid conflict across the Barrens.

Thork needs provisions restored to the Crossroads after a supply caravan is ambushed. The outpost links Horde travel, trade, and defense across the Barrens, and cargo arrives from Durotar and Mulgore. Without it, shortages of provisions, tools, and arms threaten daily life in the harsh wilderness.

Razormane quilboar have taken the crates. These swine-beasts contest Horde control across central Kalimdor. They hauled the cargo to their thorn-bush camps and keep it there. Thork sends trusted warriors into Razormane territory to recover the supplies for the Horde.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: That attack on the caravan contained supplies we desperately needed.

You've been brave enough to take on the Razormane tribe so far, and I will ask you to do so again, but this time, I wonder if I could ask you to keep your eyes open for some of our lost supplies. You can probably find them throughout their camps, the quilboar getting fat off their dishonorable acts.
The people of the Crossroads would be in your debt.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How goes your search for the supplies, friend? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Haha! Thank you, friend! This will help us greatly. You're a boon to the Crossroads and to the Horde. If there is anything I can do for you, please, let me know.
